ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels occupy approximately 75% of the visible surface, with low-intensity black pixels providing sharp contrast along the periphery and notch regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white blobs cover the central and distal portions of both lobes. Low-intensity black banding is mapped along the entire trailing edge, broadening significantly towards the median notch. Vertical black streaks and pixel-level mottling are distributed across the white regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a vertex angle of approximately 65 degrees and a pixel depth significant relative to the horizontal span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitude peaks ranging from 5-15 pixels relative to the local baseline. Notable large-scale jagged indentations on the left lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer edges follow a convex trajectory sweeping upward toward the tips, with the trailing edge displaying a complex irregular curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast white and textured pixels (barnacles) concentrated on the distal tips. A distinct, isolated dark circular pixel cluster is located on the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are detected across the white regions of both lobes, mostly oriented vertically.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy crustaceous colonization on both fluke tips; significant irregular notch on the trailing edge of the left lobe; distinct dark circular scar on the right lobe; numerous linear rake marks.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'U' shaped indentation on the trailing edge of the left lobe, approximately one-third of the distance from the notch to the tip.
